units: M. Kat. 8ᵃ לא יְעַרְעֵר וכ׳, v. עוּר Polel

senses.gloss: [to stir up strife, disturb,] to contest the legality of an action, the legitimacy of a person, his fitness as judge, witness &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:9:23">Y. Snh. III, 21ᵈ</cite> top <he>אם בא ועי׳ עֲרָרוֹ קיים</he> if he comes and protests (against the judgment given in his absence), his protest is valid.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 5:6:4">Y. Ned. V, end, 39ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מי שיבוא וִיעַרְעֵר וכ׳</he> whosoever may at some future time contest this donation (having a claim against the property); a. e.—[<cite ref="Megillah 25b:12">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>המְעַרְעֲרִים</he> those inclined to argue,—a censorial change from <he>המומרים</he> or <he>המינים</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8.]

senses.gloss: to stir on by chiding, to scold.
units: Sot. III, 3 מְעַרְעֲרִים אותה וכ׳ they (the court) chide her and make her drink by force; [Rashi seems to take our w. in the sense of encouraging]; Tosef. ib. II, 3 מְרַעְרְעִין ed. Zuck. (Var. מערערין).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>בצבת של ברזל … מדדין וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מערערין</he>, read <he>ומע׳</he>) they opened her mouth … and urged her on and forced her to drink; <cite ref="Sotah 19b">Sot. 19ᵇ</cite>. Y. ib. III, 18ᵈ bot. <he>מערערים אותה עד וכ׳</he> we urge her on to drink by chiding her until her face becomes pale; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 708:12">Yalk. ib. 708</cite> <he>מכין אותה ומע׳ וכ׳ …</he> they strike her with the broadside of a sword and urge her &c.; a. e.
